info.title: ProAct API v2
info.description: Tenant from identity, AND-combined filters, cursor pagination, standard envelopes (src/v2/CONVENTIONS.md)

maxGapSeconds.description: Largest gap between consecutive events that still merges (0 = adjacent or overlapping only)

overrideClassification.description: Merge events with different physical types or schedule classes (the earliest event wins)

preview.description: true: report before/after, exclusions and affected windows without changing anything

splitAt.description: Strictly inside the event (before now while it is open)

endTime.description: Exclusive end: after the start, not in the future
Exclusive end; omit or null for an open event

durationSeconds.description: Alternative to endTime: seconds from start (must agree with endTime within 1 s)

eventType.description: Legacy v1 type label (ProductionLoss, IOW, ...); sets default classifications

endTime.description: Exclusive end; omit or null for an open event

durationSeconds.description: Alternative to endTime: seconds from start (must agree with endTime within 1 s)

decision.description: keep_override: the user value stays; accept_source: the latest source value replaces it

sourceId.description: Source id (e.g. the PI element WebId)

afElementWebIds.description: AF element WebIds: the referenced element first, then its ancestors

connectionId.description: Connection whose rules apply (default: rules for every connection)

matchKind.description: exact_id → exact_path → pattern → af_binding (resolution order). Paths and patterns: `\` and `/` are separators, case-insensitive; `*` any run, `?` one character, `[*]` `[?]` `[[]` literals.

matchValue.description: Source id, path, glob pattern or AF element WebId

targetId.description: Unit or asset of the caller tenant

precedence.description: Patterns: higher is evaluated first; equal precedence with different targets is ambiguous

aliases.description: Further attribute names tried in order

templateName.description: PI template name ('*NoTemplate*' for frames without one)

connectionId.description: Connection the override applies to (default: all)

fieldRules.description: Merged field by field over the catalog defaults (only the listed target fields change)

parentId.description: Parent code of the same library and tenant; null makes a root (only libraries that have the field accept it; others answer 422 FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED)

category.description: reason, impact, oee (only libraries that have the field accept it; others answer 422 FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED)

defaultOeeComponent.description: reason (only libraries that have the field accept it; others answer 422 FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED)

defaultScheduleClass.description: reason (only libraries that have the field accept it; others answer 422 FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED)

defaultImpactCodeId.description: reason: default impact code (only libraries that have the field accept it; others answer 422 FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED)
